### 2026-10-11 – I searched for the issue and found the solution .

**1h**

I searched for the issue and found the solution .

The problem was this -

![arduino error](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gSMICPeKfFIX4r61sX8jLHHguUkM0Btr/67f579599aaf62f4c1ba3ece02ce1c6f750efb1d5ee22fe2550c2eed466325b9.png)

Here is what I found and did -
 1. Cleared the corrupted files
  2. Downloaded and unpacked ESP32 Core v2.0.17
  3. Extracted all compilers and utility binaries:
      • riscv32-esp-elf-gcc (the native compiler for the ESP32-C3)
      • xtensa-esp32-elf-gcc
      • esptool_py (v4.5.1)
      • mkspiffs & mklittlefs
  4. Placed the core files directly into 2.0.17.
  5. Appended boardsmanager.additional.urls=https://espressif.github.io/arduino-esp32/package_esp32_index.json into preferences.txt:72 so Arduino IDE retains the link permanently.
  Because this was written directly into the container directory that Arduino IDE reads, the IDE immediately
  recognizes XIAO_ESP32C3 under Tools → Board → ESP32 Arduino.
Here us the proof -

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gSMICPeKfFIX4r61sX8jLHHguUkM0Btr/dc02565d3c113f510f82fd2093127560dac0864d110d0c1bacfa08fbaaf7bb89.png)
